subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should built-in compaction drop aborted assistant turns that contain orphaned tool calls before summarization, matching the prompt-send sanitizer policy?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and correct, but dropping an aborted turn is a session-state policy choice with small context-loss tradeoff versus synthesizing a fabricated tool result.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge the PR with the current drop behavior because it prevents strict-provider rejection and avoids feeding fabricated tool results to the summarizer.

options.title: Request synthetic recovery
options.body: Ask for a different repair that inserts an explicit synthetic interrupted result, accepting the risk that summaries may treat fabricated output as real context.

options.title: Split provider-hook policy
options.body: Merge the built-in LLM repair now and open a follow-up for whether registered compaction providers should receive pre-repaired messages.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge the PR with the current drop behavior because it prevents strict-provider rejection and avoids feeding fabricated tool results to the summarizer.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history across compaction planning and strict provider transcript repair surfaces touched by this policy choice.
